detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The whims of the wild have inspired and driven these two new playable characters to raise their tools and weapons for The Resistance. 

The Angler and The Beekeeper bring with them a menagerie of new content to For The King II - including two all-new weapon sets, a new trait, a new merc, a new pet, and a fantastic new cosmetic skin. 

The many Seas of Fahrul are home to a plethora of aquatic creatures, from the docile Prismatic Fish to the somewhat less docile Kraken. The Angler takes advantage of the ocean's cache of long-forgotten treasures and finned fiends, fishing up treats, meals, and riches from its murky depths, all the while providing the party with movement-based combat mechanics. 

 

The Beekeeper’s hives remain largely unaffected by the chaos that inhabits the realm of Fahrul. But with less stability, fewer customers, and more danger for the Beekeeper’s beloved pet pollinator, the Beekeeper is finally mucking in with the rest of the Resistance, bringing sweet treats and spicy stings! 

 

Utilizing the forces of nature and all its splendid gifts, the Beekeeper and Angler come to For The King II alongside wild additions such as the much-requested Forest Mystic Skin! 

 

For The King II: Into The Wild Character Pack includes: 

 

Two New Playable Characters 

  • Beekeeper 

  • Angler 

 

New Weapons 

  • Bludgeon Set 

  • Harpoon Set  

 

New Content 

  • Gold-tier Trait 

  • Gold-tier Merc 

  • Gold-tier Pet 

  • Gold-tier Cosmetic Skin
